releaseNotes: GaGa 2.7.6 adds a secure in-app updater: GaGa now checks for new releases, downloads them over a verified HTTPS channel, checks the SHA-256 and size, and hands the APK to the Android installer without leaving the app. This release also fixes an SSRF issue in link previews (authenticated callers, HTTPS egress allow-list) and hardens FCM recipient isolation so a queued push can never surface under the wrong account. Privacy Policy and Terms were expanded (legal bases, retention, international transfers, GDPR/CCPA rights, liability, payments, termination), and the website gained structured data, an accessible FAQ, sitemap.xml and robots.txt. Builds on the 2.7.5 push-isolation and 2.7.4/2.7.3 frontend repairs.
